name: Terrain Heightmap Generation via Noise
definition: A self-contained Perlin-based height sampler that takes world-space X/Y coordinates and returns a single height value (Z), remapped to a specific range. Used for procedural terrain generation.
summary: Terrain Heightmap Generation via Noise converts 2D world coordinates into height values using scaled fractal noise, differing from its parent by operating directly on 2D coordinates rather than sampling a 3D scalar field.
